name: V4_2020_2024_Paper_123_Vol250_15x
universe: Prior 30 full UTC days average quote volume; minimum 20 full days; top 250; rebalance monthly using data strictly before month start
scope_caveat: Backtest only covers 525 symbols active in the 2026-10-18 snapshot, not delisted symbols.
stop: Original formation stop +0.25 ATR; use lower of that and initial liquidation proxy minus 0.5% entry-price buffer. Actual exchange liquidation must be monitored; no guarantee against liquidation.
tp: Original entry minus twice original pre-adjustment risk; existing timeout/horizon retained
alternate: 10x with otherwise identical rules for lower drawdown
